/**
 * Idea Hub & Peer Collaboration Controller
 * Real-time peer directory, live online presence tracking, project invites, and WebSocket messaging.
 */

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';
import { wsClient } from '../../js/ws.js';

// Verify student/HOD authentication
const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT', 'HOD', 'HOD_CS', 'ADMIN', 'FACULTY']);

// Render Left Dock Navigation
if (user) {
  const isHODRole = user?.role === 'HOD' || user?.role === 'HOD_CS' || user?.role === 'ADMIN';
  renderDock('idea-hub.html', isHODRole ? 'HOD' : 'STUDENT');
}

// State
let mySkills = [];
let allPeers = [];
let activeFilter = 'ALL';
let activeSearchQuery = '';
let targetCollabPeer = null;
let currentChatThread = null;

const myPin = (user.sbtetPin || user.rollNumber || user.pin || '24259-CS-025').trim().toUpperCase();
const myName = user.name || 'Student';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setupUserHeader();
  setupSkillsModal();
  setupCollabModal();
  setupInvitesDrawer();
  setupChatModal();
  setupSearchAndFilters();
  setupRealtimeWebSocket();
  
  loadMySkills();
  loadPeerDirectory();
  loadCollaborationInvites();
});

function setupUserHeader() {
  const isHOD = user.role === 'HOD' || user.role === 'HOD_CS' || user.role === 'ADMIN';
  const name = isHOD ? 'Prof. Vamshi Krishna' : myName;
  const initials = isHOD ? 'VK' : (name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase());

  const nameElem = document.getElementById('my-name');
  const metaElem = document.getElementById('my-meta');
  const avatarElem = document.getElementById('my-avatar');
  const statusBadge = document.getElementById('my-status-badge');

  if (nameElem) nameElem.textContent = name;
  if (avatarElem) avatarElem.textContent = initials || 'ST';
  
  if (isHOD) {
    if (metaElem) metaElem.innerHTML = `<span class="neu-badge neu-badge-primary" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.75rem;">Official HOD CS • Department Faculty Lead</span>`;
    if (statusBadge) {
      statusBadge.className = 'neu-badge neu-badge-primary';
      statusBadge.textContent = 'Faculty Lead';
    }
  } else {
    if (metaElem) metaElem.textContent = `PIN: ${myPin} • ${user.department || 'Computer Science & Engineering'}`;
  }
}

/**
 * 0. REAL-TIME WEBSOCKET SETUP & PRESENCE
 */
function setupRealtimeWebSocket() {
  wsClient.connect(myPin, myName);

  // When online status changes or initial connection arrives, re-render presence indicators
  wsClient.on('PRESENCE_UPDATE', () => {
    renderPeerGrid();
  });

  wsClient.on('CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED', () => {
    renderPeerGrid();
  });

  // When a new project invite arrives
  wsClient.on('IDEA_INVITE_RECEIVED', (data) => {
    loadCollaborationInvites();
    if (data?.invite) {
      alerts.info(
        'New Project Invite!',
        `${data.invite.from_name} invited you to collaborate on "${data.invite.project_title || 'a project'}"`
      );
    }
  });

  // Incoming messages for Idea Hub
  wsClient.on('NEW_MESSAGE', (payload) => {
    if (payload?.message && currentChatThread) {
      const msg = payload.message;
      if (msg.category === 'IDEA_HUB' && msg.sender_pin === currentChatThread.pin) {
        appendChatBubble({
          senderPin: msg.sender_pin,
          senderName: msg.sender_name,
          text: msg.content,
          time: new Date(msg.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
        });
      }
    }
  });
}

function updateStatusBadge() {
  const badge = document.getElementById('my-status-badge');
  if (!badge) return;

  if (mySkills.length === 0) {
    badge.className = 'neu-badge neu-badge-muted';
    badge.style.background = '#94a3b8';
    badge.style.color = '#ffffff';
    badge.textContent = 'Inactive — Skills Not Set';
  } else {
    badge.className = 'neu-badge neu-badge-success';
    badge.style.background = '#10b981';
    badge.style.color = '#ffffff';
    badge.textContent = 'Available for Projects';
  }
}

/**
 * 1. MY SKILLS MANAGEMENT
 */
function loadMySkills() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(`skills_${myPin}`);
  if (saved) {
    try {
      mySkills = JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch {
      mySkills = ['Python', 'Web Development (HTML/CSS/JS)', 'UI/UX Design (Figma)'];
    }
  } else {
    mySkills = ['Python', 'Web Development (HTML/CSS/JS)'];
    localStorage.setItem(`skills_${myPin}`, JSON.stringify(mySkills));
  }
  renderMySkillsList();
}

function renderMySkillsList() {
  const container = document.getElementById('my-skills-list');
  if (!container) return;

  updateStatusBadge();

  if (mySkills.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-skills-notice" style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic;">No skills published yet. Click "Edit My Skills" to select your skills.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = mySkills.map(skill => `
    <span class="skill-pill active" data-skill-remove="${escapeHtml(skill)}" title="Click ✕ to remove" style="cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; margin: 2px;">
      <span>✨</span>
      <span>${escapeHtml(skill)}</span>
      <span class="remove-chip-x" style="margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0.7; font-weight: 800;">✕</span>
    </span>
  `).join('');

  container.querySelectorAll('[data-skill-remove]').forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const skillToRemove = chip.getAttribute('data-skill-remove');
      mySkills = mySkills.filter(s => s !== skillToRemove);
      localStorage.setItem(`skills_${myPin}`, JSON.stringify(mySkills));
      renderMySkillsList();
      alerts.success('Skill Removed', `"${skillToRemove}" was removed from your profile.`);
    });
  });
}

function setupSkillsModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('skills-modal');
  const openBtn = document.getElementById('open-my-skills-btn');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-skills-modal');
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-skills-modal');
  const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-skills-btn');
  const addCustomBtn = document.getElementById('add-custom-skill-btn');
  const customInput = document.getElementById('custom-skill-input');
  const quickPills = document.querySelectorAll('.selectable-pill');
  const selectedContainer = document.getElementById('modal-selected-skills');

  let tempSelectedSkills = [...mySkills];

  const updateModalPills = () => {
    quickPills.forEach(pill => {
      const name = pill.getAttribute('data-name');
      if (tempSelectedSkills.includes(name)) {
        pill.classList.add('selected');
        pill.style.background = 'var(--primary-color, #4f46e5)';
        pill.style.color = '#fff';
      } else {
        pill.classList.remove('selected');
        pill.style.background = '';
        pill.style.color = '';
      }
    });

    selectedContainer.innerHTML = tempSelectedSkills.map(s => `
      <span class="skill-pill active" style="cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; margin: 2px;" data-remove="${escapeHtml(s)}">
        ${escapeHtml(s)} <small style="margin-left: 6px; font-weight: 800;">✕</small>
      </span>
    `).join('');

    selectedContainer.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const toRemove = btn.getAttribute('data-remove');
        tempSelectedSkills = tempSelectedSkills.filter(s => s !== toRemove);
        updateModalPills();
      });
    });
  };

  openBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    tempSelectedSkills = [...mySkills];
    updateModalPills();
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  });

  const closeModal = () => { modal.style.display = 'none'; };
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  cancelBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  quickPills.forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const name = pill.getAttribute('data-name');
      if (tempSelectedSkills.includes(name)) {
        tempSelectedSkills = tempSelectedSkills.filter(s => s !== name);
      } else {
        tempSelectedSkills.push(name);
      }
      updateModalPills();
    });
  });

  const addCustom = () => {
    const val = (customInput.value || '').trim();
    if (val && !tempSelectedSkills.includes(val)) {
      tempSelectedSkills.push(val);
      customInput.value = '';
      updateModalPills();
    }
  };

  addCustomBtn?.addEventListener('click', addCustom);
  customInput?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      addCustom();
    }
  });

  saveBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    mySkills = [...tempSelectedSkills];
    localStorage.setItem(`skills_${myPin}`, JSON.stringify(mySkills));
    renderMySkillsList();
    closeModal();
    alerts.success('Skills Published', 'Your skills are now visible to peer collaborators.');
  });
}

/**
 * 2. PEER COLLABORATION DIRECTORY (REAL ROSTER WITH REAL-TIME PRESENCE)
 */
async function loadPeerDirectory() {
  try {
    const res = await api.get('/hod/roster');
    if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.students)) {
      // Default sample skills pool distributed to students to make exploration interactive
      const skillPresets = [
        ['Python', 'Web Development', 'FastAPI'],
        ['UI/UX Design', 'Figma', 'Poster Design'],
        ['PPT Making', 'Technical Writing', 'Seminar Presentation'],
        ['React / Next.js', 'Web Development', 'Database (SQL/MongoDB)'],
        ['Arduino / IoT', 'Circuit Design', 'Embedded Systems'],
        ['AI / Machine Learning', 'Python', 'Database (SQL/MongoDB)'],
        ['AutoCAD / 3D CAD Drafting', 'Mini Drafter', 'C / C++'],
        ['Video Editing', 'Poster Design', 'Logo & Branding']
      ];

      allPeers = res.students
        .filter(s => s.pin.toUpperCase() !== myPin)
        .map((s, idx) => {
          const preset = skillPresets[idx % skillPresets.length];
          return {
            pin: s.pin,
            name: s.name,
            branch: s.branch || 'Computer Science & Engineering',
            year: '3rd Year',
            semester: '6th Sem',
            skills: preset,
            status: 'Available'
          };
        });
    } else {
      allPeers = [];
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to load peer directory:', e);
    allPeers = [];
  }

  renderPeerGrid();
}

function renderPeerGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('peer-grid');
  const countText = document.getElementById('peer-count-text');
  if (!grid) return;

  const onlinePins = wsClient.getOnlinePins();

  const filtered = allPeers.filter(peer => {
    const matchesSearch = !activeSearchQuery || 
      peer.name.toLowerCase().includes(activeSearchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      peer.pin.toLowerCase().includes(activeSearchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (peer.skills || []).some(s => s.toLowerCase().includes(activeSearchQuery.toLowerCase()));

    const matchesFilter = activeFilter === 'ALL' || (peer.skills || []).some(s => s.toLowerCase().includes(activeFilter.toLowerCase()));
    return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
  });

  // Sort online peers first
  filtered.sort((a, b) => {
    const aOnline = wsClient.isUserOnline(a.pin) ? 1 : 0;
    const bOnline = wsClient.isUserOnline(b.pin) ? 1 : 0;
    return bOnline - aOnline;
  });

  if (countText) {
    const onlineCount = filtered.filter(p => wsClient.isUserOnline(p.pin)).length;
    countText.textContent = `${filtered.length} Collaborator${filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (${onlineCount} Online)`;
  }

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-state-tile" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px;">
        <div class="empty-state-icon" style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
        </div>
        <h4 style="font-weight: 800;">No Collaborators Found</h4>
        <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem;">No students matched your search criteria or skill tag filter.</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(peer => {
    const initials = peer.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    const isOnline = wsClient.isUserOnline(peer.pin);

    return `
      <div class="neu-card peer-card" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;">
        <div>
          <div class="peer-card-top" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
            <div class="peer-avatar" style="position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-secondary, #e2e8f0); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary-color, #4f46e5); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised);">
              ${initials}
              <span style="position: absolute; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${isOnline ? '#10b981' : '#9ca3af'}; border: 2px solid var(--bg-primary, #f8fafc);" title="${isOnline ? 'Online Now' : 'Offline'}"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="peer-card-info" style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
              <h4 style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin: 0;">${escapeHtml(peer.name)}</h4>
              <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 2px;">
                <span class="peer-pin" style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(peer.pin)}</span>
                <span style="font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: ${isOnline ? '#10b981' : '#9ca3af'};">● ${isOnline ? 'Online' : 'Offline'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="peer-card-skills" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
            ${(peer.skills || []).map(s => `
              <span class="skill-pill ${s.toLowerCase().includes(activeFilter.toLowerCase()) ? 'active' : ''}" style="font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1); color: var(--primary-color, #4f46e5); font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(s)}</span>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="peer-card-footer" style="display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(150,150,150,0.15); padding-top: 10px;">
          <button class="neu-btn neu-btn-primary collab-req-btn" data-peer='${JSON.stringify(peer)}' style="flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700;">
            🤝 Invite to Project
          </button>
          <button class="neu-btn direct-msg-btn" data-peer='${JSON.stringify(peer)}' style="padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.8rem;" title="Direct Message">
            💬
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // Attach Invite handlers
  grid.querySelectorAll('.collab-req-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const peer = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-peer'));
      openCollabRequestModal(peer);
    });
  });

  // Attach Direct Message handlers
  grid.querySelectorAll('.direct-msg-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const peer = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-peer'));
      window.location.href = `messages.html?tab=idea_hub&chatWith=${encodeURIComponent(peer.pin)}&peerName=${encodeURIComponent(peer.name)}`;
    });
  });
}

function setupSearchAndFilters() {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('skill-search-input');
  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    activeSearchQuery = e.target.value.trim();
    renderPeerGrid();
  });

  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tag-btn');
  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      activeFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-skill') || 'ALL';
      renderPeerGrid();
    });
  });
}

/**
 * 3. COLLABORATION REQUEST MODAL
 */
function setupCollabModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('collab-request-modal');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-collab-modal');
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-collab-btn');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-collab-btn');

  const closeModal = () => { modal.style.display = 'none'; };
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  cancelBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  sendBtn?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const title = document.getElementById('collab-project-title')?.value.trim();
    const message = document.getElementById('collab-project-message')?.value.trim();

    if (!title || !message) {
      alerts.error('Required Fields', 'Please state the project topic and pitch message.');
      return;
    }

    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    sendBtn.textContent = 'Sending Invite...';

    try {
      const res = await api.post('/ideahub/invites', {
        project_title: title,
        message: message,
        from_pin: myPin,
        from_name: myName,
        to_pin: targetCollabPeer.pin,
        to_name: targetCollabPeer.name
      });

      alerts.success('Invite Dispatched!', `Collaboration invite delivered in real time to ${targetCollabPeer.name}.`);
      closeModal();
    } catch (err) {
      alerts.error('Delivery Error', err.message || 'Could not deliver invite.');
    } finally {
      sendBtn.disabled = false;
      sendBtn.textContent = 'Send Collaboration Invite';
    }
  });
}

function openCollabRequestModal(peer) {
  targetCollabPeer = peer;
  const modal = document.getElementById('collab-request-modal');
  const targetName = document.getElementById('collab-target-name');
  const targetMeta = document.getElementById('collab-target-meta');

  if (targetName) targetName.textContent = `Invite ${peer.name} to Collaborate`;
  if (targetMeta) targetMeta.textContent = `PIN: ${peer.pin} • ${peer.branch} • ${peer.year}`;

  modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

/**
 * 4. COLLABORATION INVITES DRAWER
 */
async function loadCollaborationInvites() {
  const badge = document.getElementById('pending-invites-count');
  try {
    const res = await api.get('/ideahub/invites', { pin: myPin });
    if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.invites)) {
      const pending = res.invites.filter(r => r.status === 'PENDING');
      if (badge) badge.textContent = pending.length;
    } else {
      if (badge) badge.textContent = '0';
    }
  } catch {
    if (badge) badge.textContent = '0';
  }
}

function setupInvitesDrawer() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('invites-modal');
  const openBtn = document.getElementById('view-requests-btn');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-invites-modal');
  const closeBtn2 = document.getElementById('close-invites-btn');

  const closeModal = () => { modal.style.display = 'none'; };
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  closeBtn2?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  openBtn?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    renderInvitesList();
  });
}

async function renderInvitesList() {
  const container = document.getElementById('invites-list-container');
  if (!container) return;

  container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted);">Loading incoming project invites...</div>`;

  try {
    const res = await api.get('/ideahub/invites', { pin: myPin });
    if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.invites) && res.invites.length > 0) {
      container.innerHTML = res.invites.map(inv => `
        <div class="neu-card" style="margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 14px;">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px;">
            <strong style="color: var(--primary-color, #4f46e5); font-size: 0.95rem;">${escapeHtml(inv.project_title || 'Project Collaboration')}</strong>
            <span class="neu-badge neu-badge-primary" style="font-size: 0.7rem;">${escapeHtml(inv.status)}</span>
          </div>
          <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; margin: 4px 0 8px 0; color: var(--text-main);">${escapeHtml(inv.message || 'Wants to collaborate with you.')}</p>
          <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
            <span>From: <strong>${escapeHtml(inv.from_name)}</strong> (${escapeHtml(inv.from_pin)})</span>
            <button class="neu-btn neu-btn-primary accept-invite-btn" data-from-pin="${inv.from_pin}" data-from-name="${escapeHtml(inv.from_name)}" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem;">
              Chat & Accept
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      container.querySelectorAll('.accept-invite-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const fromPin = btn.getAttribute('data-from-pin');
          const fromName = btn.getAttribute('data-from-name');
          window.location.href = `messages.html?tab=idea_hub&chatWith=${encodeURIComponent(fromPin)}&peerName=${encodeURIComponent(fromName)}`;
        });
      });
    } else {
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div style="text-align: center; padding: 36px 16px; color: var(--text-muted);">
          <p style="margin: 0; font-weight: 700;">No Incoming Invites</p>
          <p style="font-size: 0.82rem; margin-top: 4px;">When classmates want to collaborate with you on projects, their invites will appear here in real time.</p>
        </div>
      `;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: #ef4444;">Failed to load invites: ${err.message}</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * 5. PEER-TO-PEER CHAT MODAL
 */
function setupChatModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('chat-modal');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-chat-modal');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-chat-btn');
  const input = document.getElementById('chat-message-input');

  const closeModal = () => {
    modal.style.display = 'none';
    currentChatThread = null;
  };
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  const sendMessage = () => {
    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text || !currentChatThread) return;

    input.value = '';

    wsClient.send({
      type: 'SEND_MESSAGE',
      receiver_pin: currentChatThread.pin,
      content: text,
      category: 'IDEA_HUB'
    });

    appendChatBubble({
      senderPin: myPin,
      senderName: myName,
      text,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    });
  };

  sendBtn?.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  input?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
}

function appendChatBubble(msg) {
  const container = document.getElementById('chat-messages-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const isMine = (msg.senderPin || '').trim().toUpperCase() === myPin;
  const bubble = document.createElement('div');
  bubble.className = `chat-bubble ${isMine ? 'mine' : 'peer'}`;
  bubble.innerHTML = `
    <div>${escapeHtml(msg.text)}</div>
    <div class="chat-bubble-meta" style="font-size: 0.7rem; opacity: 0.7; margin-top: 4px; text-align: right;">${escapeHtml(msg.time || '')}</div>
  `;
  container.appendChild(bubble);
  container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/**
 * Samskruti Marketplace & Campus Exchange Controller
 * Real-time peer-to-peer marketplace with WebSocket live feed updates, photo capture with compression, and direct chat.
 */

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';
import { wsClient } from '../../js/ws.js';

// Verify student/HOD authentication
const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT', 'HOD', 'HOD_CS', 'ADMIN', 'FACULTY']);

// Render Left Dock Navigation
if (user) {
  const isHODRole = user?.role === 'HOD' || user?.role === 'HOD_CS' || user?.role === 'ADMIN';
  renderDock('marketplace.html', isHODRole ? 'HOD' : 'STUDENT');
}

// State
let allItems = [];
let activeCategory = 'ALL';
let activeSearchQuery = '';
let currentChatContext = null;
let uploadedImageData = null;

const myPin = (user.sbtetPin || user.rollNumber || user.pin || '24259-CS-025').trim().toUpperCase();
const myName = user.name || 'Student';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setupUserHeader();
  setupCategoryFilters();
  setupSearchInput();
  setupPhotoUpload();
  setupListItemModal();
  setupSellerChatModal();
  setupRealtimeWebSocket();
  loadMarketplaceItems();
});

function setupUserHeader() {
  const isHOD = user.role === 'HOD' || user.role === 'HOD_CS' || user.role === 'ADMIN';
  const subElem = document.getElementById('market-subtitle');
  if (subElem) {
    if (isHOD) {
      subElem.textContent = `Samskruti College (259) • Prof. Vamshi Krishna (HOD CS) • Campus Marketplace Oversight`;
    } else {
      subElem.textContent = `Samskruti College (259) • ${myName} (PIN: ${myPin}) • Verified Campus Exchange`;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 0. REAL-TIME WEBSOCKET SUBSCRIPTION
 */
function setupRealtimeWebSocket() {
  wsClient.connect(myPin, myName);

  wsClient.on('MARKETPLACE_FEED_UPDATE', (data) => {
    if (!data) return;

    if (data.action === 'CREATE' && data.item) {
      const exists = allItems.some(i => i.id === data.item.id);
      if (!exists) {
        allItems.unshift(data.item);
        renderMarketplaceGrid();
        alerts.info('New Listing', `"${data.item.title}" was just listed for ₹${data.item.price}.`);
      }
    } else if (data.action === 'UPDATE' && data.item) {
      const idx = allItems.findIndex(i => i.id === data.item.id);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        allItems[idx] = data.item;
        renderMarketplaceGrid();
      }
    } else if (data.action === 'DELETE' && data.item_id) {
      allItems = allItems.filter(i => i.id !== data.item_id);
      renderMarketplaceGrid();
    }
  });

  // Listen for new messages if chat modal is active
  wsClient.on('NEW_MESSAGE', (payload) => {
    if (payload?.message && currentChatContext) {
      const msg = payload.message;
      if (msg.category === 'MARKETPLACE' && (msg.sender_pin === currentChatContext.seller_pin || msg.sender_pin === currentChatContext.sellerPin)) {
        appendChatBubble({
          senderPin: msg.sender_pin,
          senderName: msg.sender_name,
          text: msg.content,
          time: new Date(msg.timestamp || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
        });
      }
    }
  });
}

/**
 * 1. LOAD MARKETPLACE ITEMS
 */
async function loadMarketplaceItems() {
  try {
    const res = await api.get('/marketplace/items');
    if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.items)) {
      allItems = res.items;
    } else {
      allItems = [];
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to load marketplace items:', e);
    allItems = [];
  }

  renderMarketplaceGrid();
}

function renderMarketplaceGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('marketplace-grid');
  if (!grid) return;

  const filtered = allItems.filter(item => {
    const itemCat = (item.category || '').toUpperCase();
    const targetCat = activeCategory.toUpperCase();
    const matchesCat = targetCat === 'ALL' || itemCat === targetCat;
    
    const title = (item.title || '').toLowerCase();
    const desc = (item.description || '').toLowerCase();
    const seller = (item.seller_name || item.sellerName || '').toLowerCase();
    const q = activeSearchQuery.toLowerCase();

    const matchesSearch = !q || title.includes(q) || desc.includes(q) || seller.includes(q);
    return matchesCat && matchesSearch;
  });

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-state-tile" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 48px 24px;">
        <div class="empty-state-icon" style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M6 2 3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4z"></path><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 0 1-8 0"></path></svg>
        </div>
        <h4 style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 6px;">No Items in This Category</h4>
        <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem;">No products found matching your filter. Click "+ List Item" to sell textbooks, drafters, or lab equipment.</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(item => {
    const sellerPin = (item.seller_pin || item.sellerPin || '').toUpperCase();
    const sellerName = item.seller_name || item.sellerName || 'Student Seller';
    const isMyItem = sellerPin === myPin;
    const imgUrl = item.image_url || item.image;

    return `
      <div class="neu-card item-card" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;">
        <div>
          <div class="item-badge-top" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <span class="neu-badge neu-badge-success">${escapeHtml(item.condition || 'Good')}</span>
            <span class="item-price" style="font-weight: 800; color: #10b981; font-size: 1.1rem;">₹${item.price}</span>
          </div>

          ${imgUrl ? `
            <div class="item-photo-wrapper" style="width: 100%; height: 160px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--bg-secondary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset);">
              <img src="${imgUrl}" alt="${escapeHtml(item.title)}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;" />
            </div>
          ` : ''}

          <h3 class="item-title" style="font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px;">${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3>
          <p class="item-desc" style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 6px 0 12px 0;">${escapeHtml(item.description || 'Verified student listing.')}</p>

          <div class="item-seller" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(150,150,150,0.2);">
            <span>Seller: <strong style="color: var(--text-main);">${escapeHtml(sellerName)}</strong> (${escapeHtml(sellerPin)})</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="item-actions" style="margin-top: 12px; display: flex; gap: 8px;">
          ${isMyItem ? `
            <button class="neu-btn neu-btn-danger delete-item-trigger" data-item-id="${item.id}" style="width: 100%; background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; font-weight: 700;">
              🗑️ Delete My Listing
            </button>
          ` : `
            <button class="neu-btn neu-btn-primary reserve-btn chat-seller-trigger" data-item='${JSON.stringify(item)}' style="width: 100%;">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 4px;"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>
              Chat with Seller
            </button>
          `}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // Attach Delete handlers
  grid.querySelectorAll('.delete-item-trigger').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const itemId = btn.getAttribute('data-item-id');
      if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this listing? It will immediately disappear for all students.')) return;
      try {
        const res = await api.delete(`/marketplace/items/${itemId}`);
        if (res && res.success) {
          allItems = allItems.filter(i => String(i.id) !== String(itemId));
          renderMarketplaceGrid();
          alerts.success('Listing Removed', 'Item successfully removed from the marketplace.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        alerts.error('Delete Failed', err.message || 'Could not delete item.');
      }
    });
  });

  // Attach Chat handlers
  grid.querySelectorAll('.chat-seller-trigger').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const itemData = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-item'));
      const sellerPin = itemData.seller_pin || itemData.sellerPin || '';
      const sellerName = itemData.seller_name || itemData.sellerName || 'Student';
      const itemId = itemData.id || '';
      const title = itemData.title || '';
      const price = itemData.price || '';

      // Direct to unified messaging with product context
      window.location.href = `messages.html?tab=marketplace&chatWith=${encodeURIComponent(sellerPin)}&item=${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}&title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&price=${encodeURIComponent(price)}&peerName=${encodeURIComponent(sellerName)}`;
    });
  });
}

function setupCategoryFilters() {
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('#category-filter-bar button');
  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      activeCategory = btn.getAttribute('data-category') || 'ALL';
      renderMarketplaceGrid();
    });
  });
}

function setupSearchInput() {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('market-search-input');
  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    activeSearchQuery = e.target.value.trim();
    renderMarketplaceGrid();
  });
}

/**
 * 2. PHOTO UPLOADS WITH CANVAS COMPRESSION
 */
function setupPhotoUpload() {
  const galleryInput = document.getElementById('gallery-input');
  const cameraInput = document.getElementById('camera-input');
  const previewWrapper = document.getElementById('image-preview-wrapper');
  const previewImg = document.getElementById('item-image-preview');
  const removeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-remove-image');

  const processFile = (file) => {
    if (!file || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      alerts.error('Invalid File', 'Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, WEBP).');
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const maxWidth = 1000;
        let width = img.width;
        let height = img.height;

        if (width > maxWidth) {
          height = Math.round((height * maxWidth) / width);
          width = maxWidth;
        }

        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);

        uploadedImageData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.80);
        if (previewImg) previewImg.src = uploadedImageData;
        if (previewWrapper) previewWrapper.style.display = 'block';
      };
      img.src = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  galleryInput?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      processFile(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  });

  cameraInput?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      processFile(e.target.files[0]);
    }
  });

  removeBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    resetPhotoUploadUI();
  });
}

function resetPhotoUploadUI() {
  uploadedImageData = null;
  const galleryInput = document.getElementById('gallery-input');
  const cameraInput = document.getElementById('camera-input');
  const previewWrapper = document.getElementById('image-preview-wrapper');
  const previewImg = document.getElementById('item-image-preview');

  if (galleryInput) galleryInput.value = '';
  if (cameraInput) cameraInput.value = '';
  if (previewImg) previewImg.src = '';
  if (previewWrapper) previewWrapper.style.display = 'none';
}

/**
 * 3. LIST NEW ITEM MODAL
 */
function setupListItemModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('list-item-modal');
  const openBtn = document.getElementById('btn-list-item');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-list-modal');
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-list-modal');
  const form = document.getElementById('list-item-form');

  const closeModal = () => {
    modal.style.display = 'none';
    resetPhotoUploadUI();
  };

  openBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    form.reset();
    resetPhotoUploadUI();
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  });

  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  cancelBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  form?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const title = document.getElementById('item-title')?.value.trim();
    const category = document.getElementById('item-category')?.value;
    const price = document.getElementById('item-price')?.value;
    const condition = document.getElementById('item-condition')?.value;
    const description = document.getElementById('item-description')?.value.trim();

    if (!title || !price) {
      alerts.error('Required Fields', 'Please provide item title and price.');
      return;
    }

    const payload = {
      title,
      category,
      price: parseFloat(price),
      condition,
      description,
      image_url: uploadedImageData,
      seller_name: myName,
      seller_pin: myPin,
      contact_info: user.email || myPin
    };

    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('publish-item-btn');
    if (submitBtn) {
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      submitBtn.textContent = 'Publishing...';
    }

    try {
      const res = await api.post('/marketplace/items', payload);
      if (res && res.item) {
        if (!allItems.some(i => i.id === res.item.id)) {
          allItems.unshift(res.item);
        }
      }
      alerts.success('Listing Published', 'Your item is live on the Samskruti Marketplace!');
      closeModal();
      renderMarketplaceGrid();
    } catch (err) {
      alerts.error('Listing Error', err.message || 'Failed to publish listing to the database.');
    } finally {
      if (submitBtn) {
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        submitBtn.textContent = 'Publish to Marketplace';
      }
    }
  });
}

/**
 * 4. IN-APP SELLER CHAT MODAL
 */
function setupSellerChatModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('seller-chat-modal');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-seller-chat-modal');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-seller-chat-btn');
  const input = document.getElementById('seller-chat-input');

  const closeModal = () => {
    modal.style.display = 'none';
    currentChatContext = null;
  };
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  const sendMessage = async () => {
    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text || !currentChatContext) return;

    input.value = '';
    const recipientPin = currentChatContext.seller_pin || currentChatContext.sellerPin;

    // Send via WebSocket
    const sent = wsClient.send({
      type: 'SEND_MESSAGE',
      receiver_pin: recipientPin,
      content: text,
      category: 'MARKETPLACE',
      product_id: currentChatContext.id
    });

    appendChatBubble({
      senderPin: myPin,
      senderName: myName,
      text,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    });
  };

  sendBtn?.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  input?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
}

function appendChatBubble(msg) {
  const container = document.getElementById('seller-chat-messages');
  if (!container) return;

  const isMine = (msg.senderPin || '').trim().toUpperCase() === myPin;
  const bubble = document.createElement('div');
  bubble.className = `chat-bubble ${isMine ? 'mine' : 'peer'}`;
  bubble.innerHTML = `
    <div>${escapeHtml(msg.text)}</div>
    <div class="chat-bubble-meta">${escapeHtml(msg.time || '')}</div>
  `;
  container.appendChild(bubble);
  container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/**
 * Samskruti Digital Campus Unified Messaging Controller
 * Real-time messaging powered by FastAPI WebSockets with auto-filtering tabs:
 * - Idea Hub Connections
 * - Marketplace Inquiries
 * - Direct Messages
 */

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';
import { wsClient } from '../../js/ws.js';

// Verify student/HOD authentication
const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT', 'HOD', 'HOD_CS', 'ADMIN', 'FACULTY']);

// Render Left Dock Navigation
if (user) {
  const isHODRole = user?.role === 'HOD' || user?.role === 'HOD_CS' || user?.role === 'ADMIN';
  renderDock('messages.html', isHODRole ? 'HOD' : 'STUDENT');
}

// State
let allConversations = []; // Array of conversation thread summaries
let activeConversation = null; // Currently selected conversation object
let activeFilter = 'ALL';
let searchQuery = '';

const myPin = (user.sbtetPin || user.rollNumber || user.pin || '24259-CS-025').trim().toUpperCase();
const myName = user.name || 'Student';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setupUserHeader();
  setupFilterTabs();
  setupSearch();
  setupComposer();
  setupRealtimeWebSocket();
  
  initMessagingWithUrlParams();
});

function setupUserHeader() {
  const subElem = document.getElementById('messages-subtitle');
  if (subElem) {
    subElem.textContent = `Samskruti College (259) • ${myName} (PIN: ${myPin}) • Real-Time Unified Messenger`;
  }
}

/**
 * 0. REAL-TIME WEBSOCKET SUBSCRIPTION
 */
function setupRealtimeWebSocket() {
  wsClient.connect(myPin, myName);

  wsClient.on('NEW_MESSAGE', (payload) => {
    if (!payload?.message) return;
    const msg = payload.message;

    const senderPin = (msg.sender_pin || '').toUpperCase();
    const receiverPin = (msg.receiver_pin || '').toUpperCase();
    const otherPin = senderPin === myPin ? receiverPin : senderPin;

    // Check if this message belongs to the open chat
    if (activeConversation && activeConversation.peerPin === otherPin) {
      appendMessageBubble({
        isMine: senderPin === myPin,
        senderPin: msg.sender_pin,
        text: msg.content,
        time: formatMessageTime(msg.timestamp)
      });
    } else {
      // Background alert
      alerts.info(
        `New Message from ${msg.sender_name || otherPin}`,
        msg.content.substring(0, 60) + (msg.content.length > 60 ? '...' : '')
      );
    }

    // Refresh or update thread list
    updateThreadPreview(otherPin, msg);
  });
}

function updateThreadPreview(otherPin, msg) {
  const existing = allConversations.find(c => c.peerPin === otherPin);
  if (existing) {
    existing.lastMessage = msg.content;
    existing.timestamp = msg.timestamp || new Date().toISOString();
    existing.lastTime = formatMessageTime(existing.timestamp);
    if (!activeConversation || activeConversation.peerPin !== otherPin) {
      existing.unread = true;
    }
    // Move to top of conversations list
    allConversations = [existing, ...allConversations.filter(c => c.peerPin !== otherPin)];
    renderThreadsList();
  } else {
    // Reload full threads
    loadThreads();
  }
}

/**
 * 1. LOAD THREADS FROM BACKEND API
 */
async function loadThreads() {
  try {
    const res = await api.get('/messages/threads', { pin: myPin });
    if (res && res.success && res.threads) {
      const threadsObj = res.threads;
      const combined = [];

      // Combine categorized messages into peer threads
      const allMsgs = [
        ...(threadsObj.idea_hub || []).map(m => ({ ...m, category: 'IDEA_HUB' })),
        ...(threadsObj.marketplace || []).map(m => ({ ...m, category: 'MARKETPLACE' })),
        ...(threadsObj.direct || []).map(m => ({ ...m, category: 'DIRECT' }))
      ];

      // Sort chronological
      allMsgs.sort((a, b) => (a.id || 0) - (b.id || 0));

      // Group by peer
      const peerMap = new Map();
      for (const m of allMsgs) {
        const sender = (m.sender_pin || '').toUpperCase();
        const receiver = (m.receiver_pin || '').toUpperCase();
        const otherPin = sender === myPin ? receiver : sender;
        const otherName = sender === myPin ? (m.receiver_name || otherPin) : (m.sender_name || otherPin);

        if (!peerMap.has(otherPin)) {
          peerMap.set(otherPin, {
            peerPin: otherPin,
            peerName: otherName,
            category: m.category || 'DIRECT',
            productId: m.product_id,
            ideaId: m.idea_id,
            lastMessage: m.content,
            timestamp: m.timestamp,
            lastTime: formatMessageTime(m.timestamp),
            unread: !m.is_read && sender !== myPin
          });
        } else {
          const entry = peerMap.get(otherPin);
          entry.lastMessage = m.content;
          entry.timestamp = m.timestamp;
          entry.lastTime = formatMessageTime(m.timestamp);
          if (m.category) entry.category = m.category;
          if (m.product_id) entry.productId = m.product_id;
          if (!m.is_read && sender !== myPin) entry.unread = true;
        }
      }

      allConversations = Array.from(peerMap.values()).reverse();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to load threads:', err);
    allConversations = [];
  }

  renderThreadsList();
}

function renderThreadsList() {
  const container = document.getElementById('threads-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const filtered = allConversations.filter(c => {
    const cat = (c.category || 'DIRECT').toUpperCase();
    const filter = activeFilter.toUpperCase();

    let matchesFilter = false;
    if (filter === 'ALL') {
      matchesFilter = true;
    } else if (filter === 'IDEA_HUB' && (cat.includes('IDEA') || cat.includes('COLLAB'))) {
      matchesFilter = true;
    } else if (filter === 'MARKETPLACE' && (cat.includes('MARKET') || cat.includes('PRODUCT'))) {
      matchesFilter = true;
    } else if (filter === 'DIRECT' && cat === 'DIRECT') {
      matchesFilter = true;
    }

    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = !q ||
      c.peerName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      c.peerPin.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.lastMessage && c.lastMessage.toLowerCase().includes(q));

    return matchesFilter && matchesSearch;
  });

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 32px 14px; font-style: italic;">
        No conversations found under this tab.
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = filtered.map(conv => {
    const isSelected = activeConversation && activeConversation.peerPin === conv.peerPin;
    const initials = (conv.peerName || 'CS').split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    
    const cat = (conv.category || 'DIRECT').toUpperCase();
    let tagClass = 'badge-direct';
    let tagLabel = '💬 Direct Message';

    if (cat.includes('IDEA') || cat.includes('COLLAB')) {
      tagClass = 'badge-collab';
      tagLabel = '💡 Idea Hub';
    } else if (cat.includes('MARKET')) {
      tagClass = 'badge-market';
      tagLabel = '🛍️ Marketplace';
    }

    return `
      <div class="thread-card ${isSelected ? 'active' : ''}" data-peer-pin="${conv.peerPin}">
        <div class="thread-avatar" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem;">${escapeHtml(initials)}</div>
        <div class="thread-info" style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
          <div class="thread-top-row" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
            <span class="thread-peer-name" style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">${escapeHtml(conv.peerName)}</span>
            <span class="thread-time" style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(conv.lastTime || '')}</span>
          </div>
          <span class="thread-context-badge ${tagClass}" style="display: inline-block; font-size: 0.68rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 3px 0;">${escapeHtml(tagLabel)}</span>
          <div class="thread-snippet" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">${escapeHtml(conv.lastMessage || 'Start conversation...')}</div>
        </div>
        ${conv.unread ? `<span class="unread-dot" style="width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3b82f6; display: inline-block;"></span>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  container.querySelectorAll('.thread-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const pin = card.getAttribute('data-peer-pin');
      const conv = allConversations.find(c => c.peerPin === pin);
      if (conv) selectConversation(conv);
    });
  });
}

function setupFilterTabs() {
  const btns = document.querySelectorAll('#thread-filter-bar button');
  btns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      activeFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter') || 'ALL';
      renderThreadsList();
    });
  });
}

function setupSearch() {
  const input = document.getElementById('thread-search-input');
  input?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    searchQuery = e.target.value.trim();
    renderThreadsList();
  });
}

/**
 * 2. SELECT & LOAD ACTIVE CONVERSATION
 */
async function selectConversation(conv) {
  activeConversation = conv;
  conv.unread = false;
  renderThreadsList();

  const emptyView = document.getElementById('empty-chat-view');
  const liveView = document.getElementById('live-chat-view');
  if (emptyView) emptyView.style.display = 'none';
  if (liveView) liveView.style.display = 'flex';

  // Render chat header
  const initials = (conv.peerName || 'CS').split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  const avatarElem = document.getElementById('active-peer-avatar');
  const nameElem = document.getElementById('active-peer-name');
  const subElem = document.getElementById('active-peer-sub');
  const badgeIcon = document.getElementById('context-badge-icon');
  const badgeText = document.getElementById('context-badge-text');

  if (avatarElem) avatarElem.textContent = initials;
  if (nameElem) nameElem.textContent = conv.peerName;
  if (subElem) subElem.textContent = `PIN: ${conv.peerPin}`;

  const cat = (conv.category || 'DIRECT').toUpperCase();
  if (badgeIcon && badgeText) {
    if (cat.includes('IDEA')) {
      badgeIcon.textContent = '💡';
      badgeText.textContent = `Idea Hub Collaboration`;
    } else if (cat.includes('MARKET')) {
      badgeIcon.textContent = '🛍️';
      badgeText.textContent = conv.contextTitle ? `Market: ${conv.contextTitle}` : `Marketplace Exchange`;
    } else {
      badgeIcon.textContent = '💬';
      badgeText.textContent = `Direct Message`;
    }
  }

  await loadConversationHistory(conv.peerPin);

  // Focus input
  document.getElementById('chat-composer-input')?.focus();
}

async function loadConversationHistory(otherPin) {
  const container = document.getElementById('active-messages-stream');
  if (!container) return;

  container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem;">Loading chat history...</div>`;

  try {
    const res = await api.get('/messages/history', { user_pin: myPin, other_pin: otherPin });
    if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.messages)) {
      if (res.messages.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div style="text-align: center; padding: 36px 16px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem;">
            No messages exchanged yet. Send a message below to connect!
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = res.messages.map(m => {
        const isMine = (m.sender_pin || '').toUpperCase() === myPin;
        return `
          <div class="msg-bubble ${isMine ? 'mine' : 'peer'}" style="margin: 6px 0; max-width: 75%; ${isMine ? 'margin-left: auto; text-align: right;' : 'margin-right: auto; text-align: left;'}">
            <div style="padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: ${isMine ? 'var(--primary-color, #4f46e5)' : 'var(--bg-secondary, #e2e8f0)'}; color: ${isMine ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-main)'}; font-size: 0.88rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);">
              ${escapeHtml(m.content)}
            </div>
            <div class="msg-meta" style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 3px; padding: 0 4px;">
              ${escapeHtml(formatMessageTime(m.timestamp))}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; color: #ef4444; padding: 20px;">Could not load messages: ${err.message}</div>`;
  }
}

function appendMessageBubble({ isMine, text, time }) {
  const container = document.getElementById('active-messages-stream');
  if (!container) return;

  const bubble = document.createElement('div');
  bubble.className = `msg-bubble ${isMine ? 'mine' : 'peer'}`;
  bubble.style.cssText = `margin: 6px 0; max-width: 75%; ${isMine ? 'margin-left: auto; text-align: right;' : 'margin-right: auto; text-align: left;'}`;
  bubble.innerHTML = `
    <div style="padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: ${isMine ? 'var(--primary-color, #4f46e5)' : 'var(--bg-secondary, #e2e8f0)'}; color: ${isMine ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--text-main)'}; font-size: 0.88rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);">
      ${escapeHtml(text)}
    </div>
    <div class="msg-meta" style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 3px; padding: 0 4px;">
      ${escapeHtml(time)}
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(bubble);
  container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

/**
 * 3. COMPOSER & SEND MESSAGE
 */
function setupComposer() {
  const form = document.getElementById('chat-composer-form');
  const input = document.getElementById('chat-composer-input');

  form?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text || !activeConversation) return;

    input.value = '';
    const nowTs = new Date().toISOString();
    const timeFormatted = formatMessageTime(nowTs);

    // Optimistic UI append
    appendMessageBubble({
      isMine: true,
      text,
      time: timeFormatted
    });

    // Send directly over WebSocket
    const sent = wsClient.send({
      type: 'SEND_MESSAGE',
      receiver_pin: activeConversation.peerPin,
      content: text,
      category: activeConversation.category || 'DIRECT',
      product_id: activeConversation.productId,
      idea_id: activeConversation.ideaId
    });

    // Update conversation state preview
    activeConversation.lastMessage = text;
    activeConversation.timestamp = nowTs;
    activeConversation.lastTime = timeFormatted;
    renderThreadsList();
  });
}

/**
 * 4. URL PARAMETERS HANDOVER
 */
async function initMessagingWithUrlParams() {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const tab = urlParams.get('tab');
  const chatWith = urlParams.get('chatWith');
  const peerName = urlParams.get('peerName') || chatWith || 'Campus Peer';
  const itemId = urlParams.get('item');
  const itemTitle = urlParams.get('title') || '';
  const itemPrice = urlParams.get('price') || '';

  // Select tab if provided
  if (tab) {
    activeFilter = tab.toUpperCase();
    const btn = document.querySelector(`#thread-filter-bar button[data-filter="${activeFilter}"]`);
    if (btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('#thread-filter-bar button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
    }
  }

  await loadThreads();

  if (chatWith) {
    const cleanPeerPin = chatWith.trim().toUpperCase();
    let conv = allConversations.find(c => c.peerPin === cleanPeerPin);

    if (!conv) {
      // Create fresh conversation object
      conv = {
        peerPin: cleanPeerPin,
        peerName: peerName,
        category: (tab && tab.toUpperCase().includes('MARKET')) || itemId ? 'MARKETPLACE' : ((tab && tab.toUpperCase().includes('IDEA')) ? 'IDEA_HUB' : 'DIRECT'),
        productId: itemId ? parseInt(itemId, 10) : null,
        contextTitle: itemTitle ? `${itemTitle}${itemPrice ? ` (₹${itemPrice})` : ''}` : null,
        lastMessage: 'Starting conversation...',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        lastTime: 'Just now',
        unread: false
      };
      allConversations.unshift(conv);
      renderThreadsList();
    } else {
      if (itemId) conv.productId = parseInt(itemId, 10);
      if (itemTitle) conv.contextTitle = `${itemTitle}${itemPrice ? ` (₹${itemPrice})` : ''}`;
    }

    selectConversation(conv);
  } else if (allConversations.length > 0 && !activeConversation) {
    selectConversation(allConversations[0]);
  }
}

function formatMessageTime(ts) {
  if (!ts) return '';
  try {
    const d = new Date(ts);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/**
 * Student Profile & Security Management Controller
 * Dynamically binds active session records and manages editable contact info.
 */

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';

// Verify student authentication
const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT', 'HOD', 'HOD_CS', 'ADMIN']);

// Render Left Dock Navigation
if (user) {
  renderDock('profile.html', user.role || 'STUDENT');
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  populateStudentProfile();
  setupEditContactModal();
});

function getActiveStudentInfo() {
  const sessionUser = api.getUser() || JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dc_user') || localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
  const pin = (sessionUser.sbtetPin || sessionUser.rollNumber || user.sbtetPin || user.rollNumber || '24259-CS-039').trim().toUpperCase();
  const name = sessionUser.name || user.name || 'Kakarla Rakesh';

  // Branch mapping
  let branch = sessionUser.department || 'Computer Science & Engineering';
  if (pin.includes('-AI-')) branch = 'Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI)';
  else if (pin.includes('-CS-')) branch = 'Computer Science & Engineering (CS)';
  else if (pin.includes('-EC-')) branch = 'Electronics & Communication (EC)';
  else if (pin.includes('-EE-')) branch = 'Electrical & Electronics (EE)';
  else if (pin.includes('-M-')) branch = 'Mechanical Engineering (MECH)';
  else if (pin.includes('-CIV-')) branch = 'Civil Engineering (CIV)';

  // Semester mapping
  const semNum = sessionUser.semester || user.semester || 3;
  const semText = `Semester ${semNum} (${semNum <= 2 ? '1st Year' : semNum <= 4 ? '2nd Year' : '3rd Year'})`;

  // Custom saved contact details
  const savedContact = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`contact_${pin}`) || '{}');

  return {
    pin,
    name,
    branch,
    scheme: sessionUser.scheme || 'SBTET C-24',
    semester: semText,
    batch: sessionUser.batch || '2024 - 2027',
    mobile: savedContact.mobile || sessionUser.phone || '+91 98765 43239',
    parentMobile: savedContact.parentMobile || '+91 98765 43299',
  };
}

function populateStudentProfile() {
  const student = getActiveStudentInfo();
  const initials = student.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();

  // Header banner elements
  const avatarElem = document.getElementById('profile-avatar');
  const nameElem = document.getElementById('profile-student-name');
  const deptSub = document.getElementById('profile-dept-sub');
  const badgePin = document.getElementById('profile-badge-pin');
  const badgeScheme = document.getElementById('profile-badge-scheme');

  if (avatarElem) avatarElem.textContent = initials;
  if (nameElem) nameElem.textContent = student.name;
  if (deptSub) deptSub.textContent = `${student.branch} • Samskruti College (259)`;
  if (badgePin) badgePin.textContent = student.pin;
  if (badgeScheme) badgeScheme.textContent = student.scheme;

  // Academic Details (Locked)
  const profScheme = document.getElementById('prof-scheme');
  const profBranch = document.getElementById('prof-branch');
  const profPin = document.getElementById('prof-pin');
  const profSemester = document.getElementById('prof-semester');
  const profBatch = document.getElementById('prof-batch');

  if (profScheme) profScheme.textContent = student.scheme;
  if (profBranch) profBranch.textContent = student.branch;
  if (profPin) profPin.textContent = student.pin;
  if (profSemester) profSemester.textContent = student.semester;
  if (profBatch) profBatch.textContent = student.batch;

  // Contact Details
  const profMobile = document.getElementById('prof-mobile');
  const profParentMobile = document.getElementById('prof-parent-mobile');

  if (profMobile) profMobile.textContent = student.mobile;
  if (profParentMobile) profParentMobile.textContent = student.parentMobile;
}

/**
 * Handle Contact Information Edit Modal
 */
function setupEditContactModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('edit-contact-modal');
  const openBtn = document.getElementById('open-edit-contact-btn');
  const triggerBtn = document.getElementById('edit-contact-trigger-btn');
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-contact-modal');
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-contact-modal');
  const form = document.getElementById('edit-contact-form');

  const studentMobileInput = document.getElementById('edit-student-mobile');
  const parentMobileInput = document.getElementById('edit-parent-mobile');

  const openModal = () => {
    const student = getActiveStudentInfo();
    if (studentMobileInput) studentMobileInput.value = student.mobile;
    if (parentMobileInput) parentMobileInput.value = student.parentMobile;
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  };

  const closeModal = () => { modal.style.display = 'none'; };

  openBtn?.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  triggerBtn?.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  cancelBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  form?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const newMobile = studentMobileInput.value.trim();
    const newParentMobile = parentMobileInput.value.trim();

    if (!newMobile || !newParentMobile) {
      alerts.error('Required Fields', 'Please provide both contact numbers.');
      return;
    }

    const student = getActiveStudentInfo();
    const updatedContact = {
      mobile: newMobile,
      parentMobile: newParentMobile
    };

    localStorage.setItem(`contact_${student.pin}`, JSON.stringify(updatedContact));

    // Update in dc_user if present
    const dcUser = api.getUser();
    if (dcUser) {
      dcUser.phone = newMobile;
      api.setUser(dcUser);
    }

    populateStudentProfile();
    closeModal();
    alerts.success('Contact Details Saved', 'Your registered mobile and emergency parent contact have been updated.');
  });
}

/**
 * Samskruti Digital Campus - Dynamic SBTET Consolidated Academic Results Controller
 * Automatically synchronizes academic results for whoever is logged in.
 */

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';

// Resolve session of currently logged-in student
const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT', 'HOD', 'HOD_CS', 'ADMIN']);

function getActivePin() {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const queryPin = urlParams.get('pin');
  const storedPin = localStorage.getItem('student_pin');
  return (queryPin || storedPin || user?.sbtetPin || user?.rollNumber || '').trim().toUpperCase();
}

if (user) {
  renderDock('results.html', user.role || 'STUDENT');
}

let activeResultsData = null;
let currentSelectedSem = null;

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setupUserHeader();
  loadAcademicResults();
  setupSyncButton();
});

function setupUserHeader() {
  const pin = getActivePin();
  const subtitleElem = document.getElementById('student-meta-subtitle');
  if (subtitleElem) {
    subtitleElem.textContent = `Samskruti College (259) • State Board of Technical Education & Training Official Records (PIN: ${pin})`;
  }
}

async function loadAcademicResults() {
  const pin = getActivePin();

  try {
    const res = await api.get('/results', { pin });
    if (res && res.success) {
      renderResultsDashboard(res.data || res.results || res);
    } else {
      throw new Error('Malformed results response');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[Initial Load Fallback]:', error.message);
    triggerLiveSync(false);
  }
}

function setupSyncButton() {
  const syncBtn = document.getElementById('sync-results-btn');
  syncBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    triggerLiveSync(true);
  });
}

async function triggerLiveSync(showFeedback = true) {
  const syncBtn = document.getElementById('sync-results-btn');
  const btnLabel = document.getElementById('sync-btn-label');
  const btnIcon = document.getElementById('sync-btn-icon');
  const pin = getActivePin();

  if (syncBtn) {
    syncBtn.disabled = true;
    if (btnLabel) btnLabel.textContent = 'Syncing SBTET Marks...';
    if (btnIcon) btnIcon.classList.add('spinning');
  }

  if (showFeedback) {
    alerts.info(`Connecting to SBTET Results Gateway for PIN ${pin}...`);
  }

  try {
    const res = await api.post('/results/sync', { pin, force: true });
    if (res && res.success) {
      renderResultsDashboard(res.data || res.results || res);
      if (showFeedback) {
        alerts.success(`SBTET marksheet for ${res.data?.studentName || pin} synchronized successfully!`);
      }
    } else {
      throw new Error(res.message || 'Failed to sync marksheet');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Live Results Sync Error]:', err);
    if (showFeedback) {
      alerts.warning('SBTET Gateway busy. Displaying verified institutional records.');
    }
  } finally {
    if (syncBtn) {
      syncBtn.disabled = false;
      if (btnLabel) btnLabel.textContent = 'Sync Live SBTET Marks';
      if (btnIcon) btnIcon.classList.remove('spinning');
    }
  }
}

function renderResultsDashboard(data) {
  activeResultsData = data;
  const summary = data.summary || {};
  const currentPin = getActivePin();

  // 1. Profile Bar
  const nameElem = document.getElementById('student-display-name');
  const pinElem = document.getElementById('student-display-pin');
  const schemeElem = document.getElementById('student-display-scheme');
  const branchElem = document.getElementById('student-display-branch');

  if (nameElem) nameElem.textContent = data.studentName || user.name || 'Student';
  if (pinElem) pinElem.textContent = data.pin || currentPin;
  if (schemeElem) schemeElem.textContent = data.scheme || 'C24';
  if (branchElem) branchElem.textContent = data.branch || 'CS';

  // 2. Metrics Cards
  const cgpaElem = document.getElementById('res-cgpa');
  const creditsElem = document.getElementById('res-credits');
  const backlogsElem = document.getElementById('res-backlogs');
  const schemeFooter = document.getElementById('res-scheme-footer');
  const semFooter = document.getElementById('res-sem-footer');
  const promoFooter = document.getElementById('res-promotion-footer');

  if (cgpaElem) cgpaElem.textContent = summary.cgpa !== undefined ? summary.cgpa : '0.00';
  if (creditsElem) creditsElem.textContent = summary.creditsRatio || `${summary.creditsGained || 0} / ${summary.totalMaxCredits || 80}`;
  if (backlogsElem) {
    const backlogs = summary.activeBacklogs || 0;
    backlogsElem.textContent = backlogs;
    backlogsElem.style.color = backlogs === 0 ? 'var(--accent-success)' : 'var(--accent-danger)';
  }

  if (schemeFooter) schemeFooter.textContent = `Scheme: ${data.scheme || 'C-24'} Regular`;
  if (semFooter) semFooter.textContent = `Latest Exam: ${summary.latestSemester || 'Current'}`;
  if (promoFooter) promoFooter.textContent = `Status: ${summary.promotionStatus || 'Promoted'}`;

  // 3. Render Semester Tabs
  renderSemesterTabs(data.semesters || {}, data.availableSemesters || []);
}

function renderSemesterTabs(semestersMap, semesterList) {
  const tabContainer = document.getElementById('semester-tab-bar');
  if (!tabContainer) return;

  const sems = semesterList.length > 0 ? semesterList : Object.keys(semestersMap);
  if (sems.length === 0) return;

  // Default to latest semester
  if (!currentSelectedSem || !semestersMap[currentSelectedSem]) {
    currentSelectedSem = sems[sems.length - 1];
  }

  tabContainer.innerHTML = sems.map(semKey => {
    const semNum = semKey.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || semKey;
    const label = `${semNum}${getOrdinal(semNum)} Sem`;
    const isActive = semKey === currentSelectedSem ? 'active' : '';

    return `
      <button type="button" class="sem-btn ${isActive}" data-sem="${semKey}">
        ${label}
      </button>
    `;
  }).join('');

  tabContainer.querySelectorAll('.sem-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      tabContainer.querySelectorAll('.sem-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
      const targetSem = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-sem');
      currentSelectedSem = targetSem;
      renderSemesterTable(semestersMap[targetSem], targetSem);
    });
  });

  // Initial Table Render
  renderSemesterTable(semestersMap[currentSelectedSem], currentSelectedSem);
}

function renderSemesterTable(semData, semKey) {
  const headingElem = document.getElementById('semester-heading');
  const subHeadingElem = document.getElementById('semester-subheading');
  const statusBadge = document.getElementById('res-status-badge');
  const tbody = document.getElementById('results-tbody');

  const semNum = (semKey || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || '1';
  const romanNum = getRoman(semNum);

  if (headingElem) {
    headingElem.textContent = `Semester ${romanNum} Subject Breakdown`;
  }

  if (subHeadingElem && semData?.examMonthYear) {
    subHeadingElem.textContent = `Exam Session: ${semData.examMonthYear} • SBTET Official Record`;
  }

  const subjects = semData?.subjects || [];
  const hasBacklog = subjects.some(s => s.status === 'FAIL');

  if (statusBadge) {
    if (hasBacklog) {
      statusBadge.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="alert-triangle"></i> <span>BACKLOG DETECTED</span>`;
      statusBadge.className = 'neu-badge neu-badge-danger';
    } else {
      statusBadge.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="check"></i> <span>PASS - ALL CLEARED</span>`;
      statusBadge.className = 'clearance-badge-success';
    }
    if (window.lucide) {
      lucide.createIcons();
    }
  }

  if (tbody) {
    if (subjects.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 1.5rem;">No records available for this semester.</td></tr>`;
      return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML = subjects.map(sub => {
      const isPass = sub.status === 'PASS';
      const gradeClass = `grade-${(sub.grade || '').toLowerCase().replace('+', 'plus')}`;

      return `
        <tr>
          <td class="font-mono font-bold">${sub.code}</td>
          <td class="font-semibold">${sub.name}</td>
          <td class="text-center font-mono">${sub.internal}</td>
          <td class="text-center font-mono">${sub.external}</td>
          <td class="text-center font-mono font-bold">${sub.total}</td>
          <td class="text-center"><span class="grade-pill ${gradeClass}">${sub.grade}</span></td>
          <td class="text-center"><span class="status-pill status-${isPass ? 'pass' : 'fail'}">${sub.status}</span></td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }
}

function getOrdinal(n) {
  const num = parseInt(n, 10);
  if (num === 1) return 'st';
  if (num === 2) return 'nd';
  if (num === 3) return 'rd';
  return 'th';
}

function getRoman(n) {
  const num = parseInt(n, 10);
  const romans = { 1: 'I', 2: 'II', 3: 'III', 4: 'IV', 5: 'V', 6: 'VI' };
  return romans[num] || String(n);
}

import { api } from '../../js/api.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../js/auth-guard.js';
import { renderDock } from '../../js/dock.js';
import { alerts } from '../../js/alerts.js';

const user = requireAuth(['STUDENT']);
renderDock('/frontend/screens/02-student-portal/surplus-market.html', 'STUDENT');

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setupReserveButtons();
  setupListModal();
});

function setupReserveButtons() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.reserve-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const card = e.target.closest('.item-card');
      const title = card.querySelector('.item-title').textContent;

      alerts.success(`Campus meeting request sent to seller for "${title}". Check your notifications for meet details.`);
      btn.textContent = 'Handover Requested ✓';
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.classList.remove('neu-btn-primary');
    });
  });
}

function setupListModal() {
  document.getElementById('list-item-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    alerts.info('Opening new surplus listing form...');
  });
}
